# Design model reference

Generated from the engine's own catalogs, the same text Card Studio's describe-a-finish reads. Field lines read `` `key` (type or range): what it does ``; "— leave out" marks fields a design written from a description shouldn't set (uploads, licensed assets, internal state). A host that has its own images may still set them (`decals`, `surfaceSources`, `logo.src`). Section names in quotes ("Lighting", "Fonts") refer to headings in these references.

## CardDesign fields

- `recipe` (Recipe (see "recipe")): The finish: metal, colour, surface texture and holo foil. Fields left out take their defaults.
- `cardholderName` (string): The embossed name (upper-cased on the card). Keep the user's own if they have one; otherwise a neutral placeholder such as "Ada Lovelace".
- `cardholderBio` (string): A small second line under the name (e.g. "Member since 1843"); "" for none. Line breaks allowed.
- `decals` (Decal[]) — leave out: Stickers. They need uploaded images: always write []
- `surfaceSources` ({ front?, back? } image URLs) — leave out: Face artwork images (uploads). Always write {}
- `surfaceTreatments` ({ front?, back? } "inlay" | "printed") — leave out: How artwork is applied. Always write {}
- `materialOverride` (MaterialOverride (see below)): Optional per-field PBR overrides on top of the recipe's material maths. Prefer recipe fields; use this only for a look the recipe can't reach (e.g. a deeper clearcoat).
- `brandingOverride` (BrandingOverride (see below)): Optional material of the raised branding (name, bio, logo) with the default "default" finish.
- `frontLayout` ({ nameFontHeight?: 0.02–0.12, nameBottom?: 0.02–0.4 }): Name size and distance from the bottom edge, in card heights. On a landscape card the name stays inside ISO/IEC 7811-1's name area (nameBottom ≈ 0.05–0.21 at the default size). Usually leave out.
- `shaders` (FaceShader[] (≤ MAX_SHADER_LAYERS)): Face shader layers in order (see "Face shaders"): built-ins by id, or your own WGSL with id "custom".
- `addons` ({ shine?, vines? }): Add-on rigs that work on any card (see "Add-ons").
- `font` (font id | { source: "google", family, weight? } | null): Name/bio typeface (see "Fonts"). Leave out for the default. Or any Google Fonts family by its exact name (letters, digits, spaces; weight 100–900, default 700), e.g. { "source": "google", "family": "Fraunces" }; it loads from fonts.googleapis.com and falls back to the default offline. (Fonts from a URL or an uploaded file, source "url" / "upload", are the user's own: don't invent them.)
- `logo` (CardLogo | null): A user logo replacing the corner mark: one SVG path (see "logo"). Leave out unless the description asks for a mark.
- `lighting` (lighting id | null): Scene lighting and backdrop preset (see "Lighting"). Leave out for the neutral studio.
- `finish` (CardFinishes (see "finish")): How name, bio and logo are cut into or raised out of the metal.
- `edge` (CardEdge (see "edge")): Side-wall colour / finish and an optional polished chamfer.
- `shape` (CardShape (see "shape")): Corner radius, portrait orientation, cutouts.
- `contactless` (true | CardContactless): Adds a contactless mark beside the chip (see "contactless").
- `textLines` (CardTextLine[] (≤ 3)): Extra text lines (card number, validity, a title), rendered like the name (see "textLines").
- `scene` (CardScene (see "scene")): Product-shot staging: HDRI environment, backdrop, reflective floor. Leave out for the studio look.

## recipe

Numbers are 0–100 integers unless noted; out-of-range values are clamped by the engine.

- `material` (material id; default "silver"; "Material"): The metal family. It shapes roughness, clearcoat and reflections but NOT the hue: `color` sets the hue for every material. "glass" is a clear refractive slab.
- `pattern` ("none" | "orbit"; default "none"; "Pattern"): "orbit" lays the texture out in concentric orbits (classic guilloché rosettes); only noticeable with a patterned texture.
- `texture` (texture id; default "none"; "Texture"): Surface texture (normal + roughness map). These are fine, physical micro-textures: at whole-card size most read as a sheen or soft pattern, the detail shows close up. NOTE: "none" with grain or relief above 0 still renders brushed; set grain 0 AND relief 0 for a flat, clean metal.
- `color` ("#rrggbb"; default "#d9d6cc"; "Color"): Base colour of the metal (the hue). Rose gold ≈ #e3b3a0, yellow gold ≈ #e2c27a, bronze ≈ #a8754a, copper ≈ #c7774f, gunmetal ≈ #3d3e3c, black ≈ #151715.
- `grain` (0–100; default 30; "Grain"): Brushed-streak / texture noise strength: 0 smooth, 30 default, 80+ strong. Even at 100, `brushed` hairlines are only visible close up; for brushing that must read on the whole card, add a brushed-streak skin layer (see "Examples").
- `polish` (0–100; default 58; "Polish"): Gloss: 0 satin/matte (rough, soft reflections), 58 default, 100 mirror.
- `relief` (0–100; default 72; "Relief"): Depth of the texture's relief (normal-map strength): 0 flat, 72 default, 100 deep.
- `spectrum` (0–100; default 0; "Spectrum"): Iridescence: a thin-film hue shift with viewing angle (oil-slick / anodised rainbow tint on the metal itself). 0 none, 20–40 a hint, 100 strong.
- `abstraction` (0–100; default 100; "Abstraction (no effect)"): Kept for compatibility; no visual effect. Leave out.
- `matchHoloSides` (boolean; default true; "Match sides"): true: the back foil mirrors the front foil (and the back* fields are ignored).
- `frontHolo` (boolean; default false; "Holo (front)"): Holographic foil on the front (an additive layer over the metal).
- `holoStyle` (holo style id; default "vmax"; "Style"): Foil colour/pattern (see "Holo foil styles").
- `foilTexture` (foil texture id; default "etched"; "Foil texture"): Foil micro-texture (see "Foil textures").
- `foilIntensity` (0–100; default 78; "Intensity"): Foil strength: 15–35 faint, 50 clear, 78 default, 100 loud.
- `holoGlare` (0–100; default 68; "Glare"): Specular glare on the foil.
- `holoMotion` (boolean; default true; "Responds to motion"): The foil shifts as the card tilts (default true).
- `foilScale` (25–400 (%); default 100; "Scale %"): Foil pattern scale.
- `foilCoverage` ("cover" | "tile"; default "cover"; "Coverage"): One field over the face, or a 4×4 tiled pattern.
- `backHolo` (boolean; default false; "Holo (back)"): Foil on the back (only when matchHoloSides is false).
- `backHoloStyle` (holo style id; default "vmax"; "Style"): Back foil style (matchHoloSides false).
- `backFoilTexture` (foil texture id; default "etched"; "Foil texture"): Back foil texture (matchHoloSides false).
- `backFoilIntensity` (0–100; default 78; "Intensity"): Back foil strength (matchHoloSides false).
- `backHoloGlare` (0–100; default 68; "Glare"): Back foil glare (matchHoloSides false).
- `backHoloMotion` (boolean; default true; "Responds to motion"): Back foil follows motion (matchHoloSides false).
- `backFoilScale` (25–400 (%); default 100; "Scale %"): Back foil scale (matchHoloSides false).
- `backFoilCoverage` ("cover" | "tile"; default "cover"; "Coverage"): Back foil coverage (matchHoloSides false).

### Materials (`recipe.material`)
Ids are internal names; the labels say how each looks. Colour still comes from `color`: gold, bronze, copper or rose tones are `silver` (or `brass` for a glassier face) with the right `color`.
- `silver`: Brushed silver. Neutral stainless with a bright edge.
- `nickel`: Black nickel. Cold black with a mirror edge.
- `titanium`: Graphite. Pencil-dark and finely brushed.
- `brass`: Obsidian. Warm black with a glassy face.
- `oxide`: Anodized black. Blue-black with an oxide shift.
- `carbon`: Matte. Soft-touch dark matte.
- `glass`: Clear glass. Transparent with a refractive edge.

### Textures (`recipe.texture`)
- `none` (None): flat (only when grain = relief = 0; otherwise renders brushed)
- `brushed` (Brushed): very fine parallel hairlines with anisotropic highlights (brushed steel / satin aluminium); at card size it reads as a soft satin sheen, the streaks show only close up
- `guilloche` (Guilloché): engine-turned wave engraving; with pattern "orbit" the classic rosette
- `crosshatch` (Crosshatch): fine engraved cross-hatching
- `hammered` (Hammered): hand-hammered dimples
- `sandblasted` (Sandblasted): fine frosted grit, soft and diffuse
- `pinpoint` (Pinpoint): a regular grid of tiny dots
- `linen` (Linen): woven-cloth texture
- `carbon-fiber` (Carbon fiber): carbon-fibre twill weave

### Holo foil styles (`recipe.holoStyle`)
The foil is an additive iridescent layer over the metal. It shows only with `frontHolo: true` (and on the back with `matchHoloSides: true` or `backHolo: true`).
- `common`: faint neutral grey sheen
- `uncommon`: faint pale green-grey sheen
- `rare`: white sheen
- `holo`: classic diagonal rainbow bands
- `reverse`: silver with a rainbow wash
- `cosmos`: deep blue starfield with sparkles
- `radiant`: rainbow with a fine cross-line grid
- `amazing`: swirling rainbow spill
- `rainbow`: soft pastel rainbow
- `shiny`: subtle silvery shift with a little colour (good for "faint holo")
- `gallery`: muted rainbow, partly silver
- `ultra`: interference-like rainbow (oil-slick feel)
- `vmax`: bold diagonal ridged rainbow (the default)
- `vstar`: warm pastel, cream to rainbow
- `gold`: warm gold foil

### Foil textures (`recipe.foilTexture`)
- `etched`: fine diagonal engraved lines
- `sparkle`: scattered flashing glitter cells
- `microdot`: a dense dot screen

## Card body and branding

### finish
- `finish.name` (mark finish): Cardholder name and the extra text lines.
- `finish.bio` (mark finish): The bio line.
- `finish.logo` (mark finish): The logo, or the corner mark when there is no logo.
Mark finishes: `default` (shiny printed branding with a faint bump); `embossed` (raised in the body metal with rounded shoulders); `engraved` (cut in: a darker floor and a lit inner wall); `etched` (laser-etched: frosted, lighter, almost no relief).

### edge
- `edge.finish` ("metal" | "anodized" | "match"): metal: polished metal tinted `color`; anodized: dyed oxide in `color` with a faint shimmer; match: the face's colour.
- `edge.color` ("#rrggbb"): Edge colour (metal / anodized only).
- `edge.chamfer` (boolean): A polished, diamond-cut highlight on the bevel.
Finishes: `metal`, `anodized`, `match`. Default colours: metal #c9a45c, anodized #2f6fd6.

### shape
- `shape.cornerRadius` (0.107–0.129): Fraction of half the short side (×26.99 = mm), within ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 (3.18 mm ± 0.30): 0.107 = 2.88 mm (minimum), 0.118 = 3.18 mm (nominal, the default), 0.129 = 3.48 mm (maximum); values outside are clamped.
- `shape.orientation` ("landscape" | "portrait"): Portrait stands the card up (a quarter turn clockwise): the chip stays where ISO/IEC 7816-2 puts it on the body, near the top, and the print is laid out upright around it.
- `shape.cutouts` (cutout ids[]): See-through holes with their own walls. Not ISO (ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 cards have no holes): a design feature, placed clear of the chip contacts, the antenna and the number / name areas. lanyard: a slot by the left short edge; notch: the top-right corner; window: a round hole above the number line.
Cutouts: `lanyard`, `notch`, `window` (lanyard: a slot by a short edge; notch: a corner notch; window: a round see-through window). Standard corner radius 0.118 (3.18 mm, ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1).

### contactless
`true` or an object:
- `contactless.finish` (mark finish): Default "embossed".
- `contactless.scale` (0.4–1.2): Height relative to the chip plate's (0.4 ≈ 4.6 mm, EMVCo's 4.5 mm minimum; default 0.78 ≈ 8.9 mm). Sits right of the chip, centred on it; on a landscape card it stops short of the number line (≈ 1.0 at most).

### decals
Stickers are the user's uploads: write `decals: []`. For reading an existing design, each sticker is:
- `id` (string) — leave out: Unique per sticker.
- `side` ("front" | "back") — leave out: Which face.
- `src` (image URL) — leave out: The sticker image (an upload or a hosted file).
- `aspect` (0.01–100) — leave out: The whole picture's width / height as placed (the image's own unless stretched).
- `x` (0–100) — leave out: Centre, percent of the card's width from the left.
- `y` (0–100) — leave out: Centre, percent of the card's height from the top.
- `width` (percent) — leave out: Visible (cropped) width, percent of the card's width (× scale).
- `rotation` (degrees) — leave out: Clockwise on the front.
- `scale` (number) — leave out: Multiplies width; default 1.
- `crop` ({ x, y, w, h } 0–1) — leave out: The visible part of the image from its top left (sides ≥ 0.02); absent = the whole image.
- `flip` ({ h?, v? } booleans) — leave out: Mirror left ↔ right / top ↔ bottom.
- `tint` ({ color: "#rrggbb", amount: 0–1 }) — leave out: Recolour: luminance mapped black → color → white, mixed in by amount (#808080 at 1 = grayscale).
- `adjust` ({ brightness?, contrast?, saturation? } −1–1) — leave out: Picture corrections; 0 = unchanged.
- `opacity` (0–1) — leave out: Default 1.
- `crop.x` (0–1): Left edge.
- `crop.y` (0–1): Top edge.
- `crop.w` (0.02–1): Width.
- `crop.h` (0.02–1): Height.
- `tint.color` ("#rrggbb"): The colour mid-tones map to.
- `tint.amount` (0–1): How much of the recolour shows.
- `adjust.brightness` (−1–1): Towards white (+) or black (−).
- `adjust.contrast` (−1–1): −1 flat grey, +1 ×10 about mid-grey.
- `adjust.saturation` (−1–1): −1 grey, +1 doubled.

### textLines
Up to 3 lines of ≤ 48 characters:
- `text` (string (≤ 48 chars)): Upper-cased on the card.
- `font` (font id): Default: the design's font.
- `size` (0.4–2): Height relative to the name; default 0.8.
- `tracking` (−0.05–0.6 (em)): Letter spacing; default 0.
- `align` ("left" | "center" | "right"): Default follows placement.
- `placement` ("bottom-left" | "bottom-right" | "center" | "top"): Default "bottom-left": on a landscape card the first bottom-left line is the number line (ISO/IEC 7811-1 area 1, just below the chip), the others stack above the name.

### logo
- `logo.path` (SVG path data): One path (M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/A/Z commands and numbers only).
- `logo.viewBox` ([w, h]): The path's viewBox size (required with path).
- `logo.origin` ([minX, minY]): The viewBox origin when not 0,0.
- `logo.fillRule` ("nonzero" | "evenodd"): Path fill rule.
- `logo.src` (image URL) — leave out: Raster mask (uploads). Don't use; write a path instead.
- `logo.aspect` (number) — leave out: Aspect of `src` (raster only).
- `logo.position` (logo position): Default "corner" (top left).
- `logo.scale` (0.4–3): Height relative to the corner mark; default 1.
Positions: `corner`, `top-right`, `center`, `bottom-right`. Path data ≤ 16000 characters. Simple geometric marks only; never reproduce a real brand's logo.

### materialOverride
- `materialOverride.color` ("#rrggbb"): Replaces the recipe colour.
- `materialOverride.metalness` (0–1): 1 metal, 0 dielectric (paint/plastic).
- `materialOverride.roughness` (0–1): Overrides the polish curve.
- `materialOverride.clearcoat` (0–1): Lacquer layer amount.
- `materialOverride.clearcoatRoughness` (0–1): Lacquer roughness.
- `materialOverride.transmission` (0–1): Glass only.
- `materialOverride.thickness` (0–10): Glass only.
- `materialOverride.ior` (1–2.5): Glass only.

### brandingOverride
Same fields as materialOverride, plus:
- `brandingOverride.brandingClearcoat` (0–1): Clearcoat of the raised branding.

## Lighting, scene and fonts

### Lighting (`lighting`)
- `studio`: Studio. The neutral softbox studio every card is tuned in. Dark backdrop.
- `dramatic`: Dramatic. One hard strip from the side, deep shadows, a spotlit backdrop. Dark backdrop.
- `warm`: Warm. Late-afternoon softboxes: amber key, peach fill. Dark backdrop.
- `cool`: Cool. Overcast daylight: icy key, steel-blue fill. Dark backdrop.
- `dark`: Dark. Low key: dim panels and a black stage for bright metals. Dark backdrop.
- `light`: Light. High key: a bright white sweep and soft, even fill.
Dark and black metals need light to read: "studio" or "light" show them best face-on; "dark"/"dramatic" suit bright metals.

### scene
- `scene.environment` ("studio" | environment id): Lighting environment (an HDRI); "studio" = the default built-in studio light rig (no HDRI).
- `scene.environmentIntensity` (0.25–3): Multiplier on the environment light; default 1.
- `scene.environmentRotation` (0–360 (°)): Turns the environment about the vertical axis.
- `scene.backdrop` (backdrop id): What stands behind the card.
- `scene.backdropColor` ("#rrggbb"): Sweep / gradient colour.
- `scene.backdropBlur` (0–1): Blur of the "environment" backdrop; default 0.45.
- `scene.floor` (true | CardFloor): A reflective floor with a contact shadow.
Environments: `studio`, `softbox`, `cyclorama`, `loft`, `warm-hall`, `sunset`.
- `softbox`: A small photo studio: two octabox softboxes and a white cyclorama under a black ceiling
- `cyclorama`: Hard strobe light in a white cyclorama: crisp, bright highlights
- `loft`: A bright white loft with a tall window and curved light strips
- `warm-hall`: Late sun through tall windows, green and brick walls, a wooden floor
- `sunset`: Golden hour on a waterfront: a low sun and a blue sky
Backdrops: `none`, `sweep`, `gradient`, `environment`.
Floor fields:
- `scene.floor.reflectivity` (0–1): 0 matte (shadow only) – 1 mirror; default 0.45.
- `scene.floor.shadow` (0–1): Contact shadow strength; default 0.6.
- `scene.floor.blur` (0–1): Blur of the reflection; default 0.35.

### Fonts (`font`, `textLines[].font`)
- `inter`: Inter (sans)
- `manrope`: Manrope (sans)
- `space-grotesk`: Space Grotesk (sans)
- `unbounded`: Unbounded (display)
- `playfair`: Playfair Display (serif)
- `plex-mono`: IBM Plex Mono (mono)
